points: Your site offers a first order discount, yet 0 of 30 ads mention it. New buyers have no reason to order today. Put the discount in the opening line of three new ads and on the creative.

None of your 30 live ads shows a proof number, like a review count. A new buyer has no number to weigh before clicking. Collect one real figure and open the next three ads with it, printed on the creative.

Two ads have run 60+ days, proof they work, yet none of the 28 newer ads reuses a winner’s opening line. Build the next three as variations of the oldest winner, keeping its opening line and adding the first order discount.

Your 30 ads open with 15 different stories, and the biggest opener leads 6 ads. Spreading copy this thin means no story is tested enough to show what works. Keep the two cozy openers and build the next batch from them.
